title: GTA6 £350 Goodtime State Vice City Collection Announced
description: Rockstar Games has revealed a £349 limited Goodtime State Vice City collection for GTA6. The pricey collector's set is available for pre-order now, but does not include the game.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar Reveals £350 GTA6 Collector's Set Without the Game

As anticipation continues to build for the eventual release of *Grand Theft Auto 6*, Rockstar Games has given fans a new way to spend their money—though it certainly comes with a hefty price tag. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, the developer has announced the "Goodtime State Vice City" collection, a limited-edition bundle of physical goodies tied to the upcoming game.

### A Pricey Package for Hardcore Fans

Priced at a staggering £349, the Goodtime State Vice City collection is aimed squarely at the most dedicated collectors in the *GTA* community. The bundle features a variety of naughty and themed items that capture the chaotic, sun-drenched aesthetic of Vice City. Gaming media outlets have playfully noted that the contents of this box are eccentric enough that you definitely wouldn't be able to get them through airport security.

However, one detail has already sparked discussion among the community: **the £349 box does not include a copy of the game itself.** Buyers will be paying purely for the physical memorabilia, meaning anyone wanting to actually play *GTA6* when it launches will need to purchase the software separately.

### Pre-Orders Are Live Now

Despite the lack of a game disc or digital code and the eye-watering price point, Rockstar has confirmed that the Goodtime State Vice City collection is available for pre-order right now. Whether this ultra-expensive bundle will sell out instantly to passionate collectors or face skepticism from mainstream players remains to be seen.

### Editor's Take

Rockstar's latest merchandise drop proves once again that the *GTA* brand commands serious premium power. While a £349 price tag without the actual game is a bitter pill for many, collector's editions of this scale often appeal directly to hardcore enthusiasts rather than casual players. If you have the cash to burn, it's a flashy way to rep Vice City; otherwise, saving your money for the actual game might be the wiser move.
